thread:
Rina K: Heads-up — EdgeNova reached out. They want a joint marketplace listing + coordinated go-live next Thursday (08:00 UTC). Asking for a co-branded hero, 1-line tech hook, partner quote, SI integration doc link, and localized short desc (EN/DE/JP). Can we confirm owners?

Tom (Product Marketing): We should aim for a staged publish: internal preview Tue, legal sign-off Wed EOD, public Wed 08:00 UTC. Is EdgeNova flexible on embargo?

EdgeNova Partner: We're targeting Thu 08:00 UTC to align with their partner summit. Embargo until Thu 07:30 UTC preferred.

Rina K: Ok noted — we'll target Thu 08:00 UTC. That means internal reviews Tue, legal Wed noon.

Leo S: I'll produce the listing metadata and short description. Can someone surface the latency/cost datapoints we want to call out? Prefer a simple measurable stat.

Maya (Growth): For marketplace CTA, recommend "Try in your account" + link to 1-click deploy. Also want a short customer blurb if we can pull one.

Tom (Product Marketing): Draft hero line proposal: "EdgeNova + Redwood Inference: edge-accelerated LLM inference with enterprise privacy and <2x cost efficiency for bursty workloads." Thoughts?

Nadia (Legal): Please route co-brand assets and quote to legal by Tue 10:00 UTC for the quick review lane. We'll flag any IP or trademark issues.

OpsBot: NOTE: staging slot reserved: 2026-04-16T06:00Z. Dry-run scheduled: 2026-04-15T18:00Z. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-edge-nova

Rina K: Owners: Tom (hero & press), Leo (listing metadata + localization), Maya (growth CTA + deploy), Nadia (legal), Leo/Sahil (integration doc link). React with :white_check_mark: when acknowledged.

Leo S: :white_check_mark: I'll start i18n copy for DE/JP and file on our CMS.

Tom (Product Marketing): I'll draft the partner quote placeholder and reach out to EdgeNova for a final exec line.

EdgeNova Partner: We'll provide a short exec quote and the brand kit (SVGs, fonts, usage) by EOD today. Also providing SI lead: integra@edgenova.ai

Maya (Growth): Small ask — can we include an "Integration guide (2-min)" video link on the listing? Ops prefers small multimedia.

Rina K: Good idea. Leo, can you add a video asset slot and a short transcript?

Leo S: Yep. I'll add a video field and a 1-paragraph transcript.

Tom (Product Marketing): Proposed one-line tech hook for hero: "Sub-40ms token latency at the edge when paired with EdgeNova neural fabric." Keep it punchy.

Leo S: We'll need proof points. Ops, can you provide p95 numbers from staging with EdgeNova config?

OpsBot: p95 numbers available in staging: 38ms average for short-seq workloads (tokenized tests). Attaching telemetry export to runbook.

Nadia (Legal): Quick note on co-branding: do not modify partner logos. Provide both-on-white and on-dark variants. Legal needs to confirm usage, but brand kit should comply.

Tom (Product Marketing): Draft press checklist I'm adding here:
- Hero line + subhead (Tom)
- Partner quote (EdgeNova)
- 1 tech stat & graph (OpsBot/Leo)
- Listing assets: banner 1200x600, logo SVG, 600x600 tile (EdgeNova)
- 2-min integration video + transcript (Maya/Leo)
- Integration guide link (/docs/partners/edgenova-integration) (Sahil)
- Localization (DE/JP) (Leo)
- Legal sign-off (Nadia)

Sahil (Engineering): (joining) I'll draft the integration doc. Plan: short install steps, KV cache notes, quantization profile recommended, and a troubleshooting section. Will publish skeleton at https://redwood.internal/docs/edgenova-integration-skeleton

Rina K: Please keep the integration doc <1 page for the listing, with a link to the full guide for SI partners.

EdgeNova Partner: Confirmed — we'll provide logo pack + hero images and a short case-study snippet by EOD.

Maya (Growth): Also recommend adding a small "Partner badge" for co-marketing programs. Ops: any issues with adding badges to the marketplace UI?

OpsBot: Marketplace UI supports a single badge field and customizable CSS classes. Frontend deploy scheduled during dry-run window.

Nadia (Legal): Reminder: embargo exceptions need to be called out now. If any partner has press commitments, flag immediately.

Rina K: No external press commitments reported by EdgeNova. They requested the summit alignment only.

Tom (Product Marketing): Timeline check:
- Today: EdgeNova assets + exec quote (partner)
- Tue 10:00 UTC: Legal review cutoff
- Tue 18:00 UTC: Internal content freeze
- Wed 06:00 UTC: Final QA in staging
- Thu 07:30 UTC: Embargo lift
- Thu 08:00 UTC: Public go-live
Is everyone confident?

Leo S: Yes, assuming assets land today. I'll queue localization and CMS deploy.

Sahil (Engineering): I'll have the integration snippet and example CLI by Tue EOD. Example snippet:
```
redwood deploy --partner edgenova --config edgenova-optimized.yaml
```

Maya (Growth): I'll craft the CTA flows for the listing and GA funnel.

OpsBot: REMINDER: Dry-run checklist (runbook steps 1-6) must be green before Wed 12:00 UTC.

Rina K: Great. I'll keep this thread as the source of truth and post updates when assets arrive. Thanks all.

EdgeNova Partner: Sending assets now via secure share. Exec quote incoming in 30m.

Leo S: Received assets. Starting tile prep and transcript.

Nadia (Legal): Received brand kit. Starting review — will flag if anything needs changes.

Tom (Product Marketing): Dropping draft hero/subhead here by EOD.

Rina K: Please acknowledge when you've completed your deliverables. We'll run the dry-run tomorrow.
